name: mammoth-rc75-parked-empty-engine-on
note: Mammoth (CAT 793D) RC75 front-left float bench, 2026-10-22 (owner-approved 3 runs + 1 spare): parked, handbrake on, ENGINE ON (the EngineStart/EngineShutdown shakers are defined since RC63), no pedal or steer, 30 s of 10 Hz probes after the scene is ready. Same pad and place as mammoth_parked_empty.json (roamer105_acceptance, pad top y 60.0, truck at (0, 61.2, -18)). RC74/RC75 rig: front carriers BoneSuspFront{Left,Right}_cdt at the front wheel centres (tpl +-2.504, 1.682, 3.387; +x = truck left = cab side), rear link BoneSuspRear_cdt lowered 0.13 m (0, 1.552, -2.33) and the soft stage BoneSuspRearSoft_cdt at (0, 1.682, -2.33) carrying both duals. Limits from design_rc75.json (prismatic + = droop, Game 2026-10-14). Launch 1 (2026-10-22) found the scene-spawned truck already carrying 206.8 t (PropLoadVolume, volume 117.6 of 124.0) with spawnFull unset, so this scenario is in fact loaded ~95 %; mammoth_rc75_parked_unloaded.json empties it. readback adds the SSL filter view (filters) and the load volume (load). wheelNames = the class slot order (slot 0 FR, slot 1 FL).
